attributes.title: NHIA 2027 Annual Conference
attributes.summary:
NHIA 2027 takes place March 19 to 23, 2027, at the Gaylord Pacific Resort & Convention Center in the San Diego area. It is the main yearly meeting for home and alternate-site infusion: pharmacists, pharmacy technicians, infusion nurses, dietitians and the executives who run infusion pharmacies. Preconference seminars cover the foundations of home infusion, sterile compounding, parenteral nutrition (new for 2027) and an executive track, and there is a separate sterile compounding clinic.

NHIA says the recorded conference sessions are worth more than 30 CE hours for pharmacists, technicians, nurses and dietitians; the exact live CE total and ACPE activity numbers are not published yet. General conference registration is $930 for members and $1,195 for nonmembers through January 6, 2027, rising to $1,270 and $1,575 from February 18. Students and residents with NHIA student membership register free until March 12.

The group hotel rate at the Gaylord starts at $349 per night and is available until February 23, 2027 or until the block sells out; booking details come with the registration confirmation.
